definitions.explanation: The person in charge of managing and overseeing the operations of a factory or manufacturing plant.

examples.japanese: {工場長|こうじょうちょう}に{報告|ほうこく}した。
examples.english: I reported to the factory manager.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{工場長|こうじょうちょう}が{着任|ちゃくにん}した。
examples.english: The new factory manager took up the position.

examples.japanese: {工場長|こうじょうちょう}は{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}に{特|とく}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: The factory manager puts particular emphasis on safety management.

notes:
A compound of {工場|こうじょう} (factory) and {長|ちょう} (chief, head). The {長|ちょう} suffix is a productive pattern for titles: {社長|しゃちょう} (company president), {部長|ぶちょう} (department head), {課長|かちょう} (section chief).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工場長|こうじょうちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to assume the position of factory manager
- {工場長|こうじょうちょう}の{判断|はんだん}: the factory manager's decision
- {工場長|こうじょうちょう}{代理|だいり}: acting factory manager

RELATED JOB TITLES:
- {副|ふく}{工場長|こうじょうちょう}: deputy factory manager
- {製造|せいぞう}{部長|ぶちょう}: head of manufacturing
- {現場|げんば}{監督|かんとく}: site supervisor, floor manager
